Fixed and verified in prod. Root causes: (1) results had no total row so the LLM summed 102 rows mentally ($1.12B vs true $1,174.2M); (2) my own prompt quoted the bad agency-filter SQL as an anti-example and the model imitated it, producing a NULL-total 'no grant funding' answer on the first retry. Fixes: grant bullet is now a copy-exactly ROLLUP query against summary_grant_funding (locally verified, TOTAL row first); the anti-example prose no longer quotes SQL; refine rubric forbids totaling long lists (no total row = no overall figure). Regenerated through prod: SQL matches verbatim, 103 rows, answer states $1.174 billion exactly, remainder described qualitatively. Cached. Also removed ', in plain English' from the subtitle per Evan.

Fixed and verified through prod (8c5fcca). (1) Benefits hallucination: second confirmed instance of negative-example imitation — both prompts quoted 'plus benefits' as the forbidden phrase and the model reproduced it. Fixed: added ORDER BY 1 to the DISTINCT enum/sample queries in both schema-description builders. Fixed through four rounds of prod verification. Started as: spend_category ILIKE '%technology%' matched ZERO rows citywide, so the bot said Louisville spends nothing on technology (plus a false 'FY2025 still in progress' claim). Fixes: (1) topic-vocabulary prompt section mapping everyday words to real data values, with the rule that an empty topical filter means the filter is wrong, not that spending is absent; (2) data_facts now names 2026 as in-progress and 2025 as the most recent COMPLETE year — false-partial claim gone; (3) prose alone didn't stop the model ANDing department AND category ($3.7-4.3M vs real $22.4M/$19.9M), so a copy-exact UNION query is prescribed (same remedy as the grant total); (4) with both figures right the model summed them into a $42.3M 'combined' total — double-counting the overlap — so the tech bullet forbids combining the two views and the refine rubric gained a general rule: only add mutually exclusive slices. Final prod answer states $22.4M and $19.9M separately with an honest caveat, no invented total.
